name: Claude Code on the web
gloss: A session in a cloud container on a fresh clone, started by you or by a Routine. Its work reaches main through a branch and a PR; tracker state and filed errands go to main directly.

name: Claude Code CLI or Cowork
gloss: A session on your own machine. Its edits sit in a local copy until it pushes.

name: Gemini through the laptop daemon
gloss: The daemon polls web-tools-private's main every couple of minutes. An ask a session filed goes to a Gemini agent that runs commands on the laptop, and the reply lands in errands/results.

name: scheduled-tasks workflow
gloss: Runs hourly on GitHub's machines, reads web-tools-private's scheduled-tasks registry, runs the statute check itself, and starts the other scheduled workflows when they are due.

name: activity-cache workflow
gloss: Refreshes the activity, file, document and session caches in web-tools-private's state/. Started hourly by the scheduled-tasks workflow, and by each push to web-tools main.

name: wsl-fetch workflow
gloss: Fetches the Legislature's bill data and commits the snapshot under pages/wsl-sync/data/ on web-tools main. Started monthly by the scheduled-tasks workflow, or by hand.

name: Web Tools app: cache refresh
gloss: The app rewrites its derived caches in web-tools-private's state/ when a tab opens and on Refresh.

name: Web Tools app: your taps
gloss: A write you make by tapping in the app, such as a jot, a pin, a schedule edit or an errand closed. Its subject ends with via Web Tools.

name: Phone shortcuts
gloss: Shortcuts on the phone commit their run logs to web-tools-private through Log-Repo, run by hand or on an automation.

name: Session record hook
gloss: When a session goes idle, a hook commits the session's record to web-tools-private's sessions/.

name: News fetch hook
gloss: When a session starts and the news ledger is two days stale, a hook fetches the feeds and commits the ledger to home's main.
